stem: A parent asks whether warm oil will soothe a child with a painful, tender outer ear canal; which reply is best?

options.text: It often hurts in otitis externa
It is first-line for diffuse otitis externa
It should be used once hearing loss appears
It is the preferred approach for itchy otitis externa
It is required before ENT referral

explanation: Otitis externa: warm oil is not a soothing measure because it often hurts in otitis externa.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because warm oil often hurts in otitis externa, so it is not a helpful soothing measure.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because warm oil is not first-line treatment for diffuse otitis externa.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because hearing loss is not an indication to use warm oil.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because itchy otitis externa is not treated with warm oil as the preferred approach.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because ENT referral does not require trying warm oil first.

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
